forum.notice_default: Get to know the community, explore the discussions, and join the conversation.
forum.empty_home: This homepage has no widgets yet.
forum.load_error: This section could not be loaded.

admin.variables_help: Use the variables below in widget titles, subtitles, text blocks, button labels, image captions/alt text, search placeholders, statistics labels and page banner text. Username and display name become Guest for visitors. Values render as plain text, once; unknown variables are preserved. URLs, queries, styles, navigation labels and third-party widgets are not expanded.
admin.variables_defaults: Defaults use a double-quoted JSON string after a comma. They apply only when a known value is missing or empty; an empty string is allowed. Existing variables without defaults retain their behavior. Unknown names or malformed syntax remain unchanged. Defaults are plain text and are not expanded again.
admin.variables_escape: Double the braces to display a variable literally, for example:
admin.button_style_help: Automatic preserves the first banner button as primary and all existing link styles. An explicit choice is kept when buttons are reordered.
admin.spacing_help: Both are off by default. Padding controls the bottom of the content surface; spacing controls the gap to the next widget in the same region. Provider content must use a standard FoF content wrapper for its padding to be controlled.
admin.stats_font_help: Blank keeps the existing appearance: numbers 17px/650, labels 12px/normal. Set each independently (8–120px). Font families must already be available on the site or device; no font is downloaded.
admin.intro: Build a homepage from reusable widgets. Save your changes, then open the homepage to review them.
admin.load_mode: Data loading on the first home page visit
admin.load_mode_help: Preload includes data, including search results, in the first page response. Async loads it after the page. Navigation from another page uses asynchronous placeholders in either mode.
admin.loading_height_help: Blank or 0 estimates from the item count. FoF widgets reuse a measured height at the same width, initially reserving 120px. Applies only while loading.
admin.fof_loading_help: FoF data loading is controlled by its provider. Providers supporting initial data can use the FoF Widgets Core setting. Their components and permission checks are preserved.
admin.animate_numbers: Animate statistics after loading (respects reduced motion)
admin.custom_font_size_help: Blank uses 24px. Enter a value from 12–120px.
admin.custom_font_family_help: CSS font family list, e.g. Georgia, serif. Blank inherits the site font. Fonts must already be available in the browser or on the site.
admin.custom_font_color_help: Applies to this theme and its high-contrast mode. Enter a hexadecimal color, or leave blank to inherit the default text color.
admin.text_margin_bottom_help: Applies to every text style and is independent of theme colors. Blank keeps the 14px default; enter 0–120px.
admin.content_safe_width_help: Percentage of the available width inside the widget padding (1–100%), preserved on narrow screens. The safe area follows left, center or right alignment. Blank keeps the original layout; independent of theme colors.
admin.image_scale_help: Image width as a percentage of the background container width, preserving its aspect ratio. The image always fills the background height, cropping horizontal overflow on narrow screens. Use horizontal and vertical position to choose the visible area.
admin.hero_subtitle_help: The subtitle supports line breaks; leave blank to hide it.
admin.hero_enabled_help: Controls only the DIY homepage banner. Enabled by default; other pages such as All Discussions are unaffected.
admin.hero_title_help: Leave blank to use the navigation label. Navigation and browser tab titles remain independent.
admin.hero_show_icon: Show an icon before the page banner heading
admin.hero_icon_help: An image takes priority over icon classes; leave both blank for no icon.
admin.guest_home: Show this homepage at / for guests
admin.routes_help: Enabled opens DIY Homepage at / for everyone; Guests only does so for visitors. Disabled keeps the forum default (falls back to /all if that default is /home). /home remains available in every mode. Existing sites keep their previous behavior.
admin.sticky_sidebar: Keep the right column visible while scrolling on desktop

region_help.fullWidth: Below the page banner, spanning the left navigation, main and right columns. Suitable for news and other full-width widgets.
region_help.top: Spans the main and right columns. The forum’s left navigation stays in place.
region_help.main: The central stream, in the order shown below.
region_help.sidebar: Uses the same sidebar width as the discussion index. Stacks below on small screens.
region_help.configOnly: Keep reusable instances off this homepage. With Friends of Flarum Widgets enabled, they can be placed on other forum pages through its widget store.

admin.title: Title
admin.subtitle: Subtitle
admin.json_help: Copy this JSON to export the layout. To import, paste a version 1 configuration, apply it, and save. Server validation runs when saving.
admin.invalid_config: Use version 1, up to 50 widgets, unique IDs and valid regions and audiences.
admin.unavailable_type: The extension providing this widget is unavailable. Its configuration is preserved.
admin.bridge_help: With the optional Friends of Flarum Widgets extension enabled, native instances also appear in its widget store and can be placed on other forum pages. Configuration only keeps an instance off this homepage. Audience and enabled settings still apply.

fields.caption: Image caption
fields.showBio: Show the user’s biography when available

field_help.query: Use Flarum search syntax, for example tag:news. For users, use the user search supported by your forum.
field_help.ids: Numeric IDs separated by commas or spaces; up to 20. If set, they take priority over search and retain this order. Invisible records are omitted.
field_help.discussion_ids: Up to 20 numeric IDs, separated by commas or spaces. These lead in the specified order; search results fill remaining slots without duplicates. Invisible records are omitted.
field_help.widgetId: Uses the provider’s original component, state and availability checks. Enable the provider extension and widget first.
field_help.imageUrl: Use a local path beginning with / or a complete http(s) URL.
field_help.showExcerpt: Independent of featuring the first discussion; disabling hides all excerpts. With FoF Synopsis enabled, ordinary excerpts retain its content, tag settings and user display preferences.

admin.online_permission: View the number of online members (without their identities)
admin.radius_help: Leave blank to follow Flarum’s Start a Discussion button. Zero gives square corners. Applies to native surfaces and standard FoF content wrappers.
admin.override_heading_help: Off: keep the provider’s original heading content, subtitle, links and layout. On: replace this homepage instance’s heading with the content and layout options below; other FoF placements are unchanged. Heading style applies in either mode. Stored values are kept when switched off.
admin.title_style_help: Choose the standard or emphasized heading style, or inherit the page appearance. For imported FoF widgets this applies to the standard provider heading even when override is off, without replacing its content or layout.
admin.emphasized_help: Applies to native headings and standard FoF headings, independently of heading override. Provider content and layout are retained when override is off.
admin.texts_help: Add, remove and reorder text blocks. Blocks may appear before or after the actions, align independently and set their own bottom spacing. Remove all blocks for a banner without text.
admin.background_help: Theme preserves the default appearance. Custom backgrounds have separate light/dark settings, also used for the corresponding high contrast modes. Gradients blend both colors and images; blank colors use theme colors. Legacy settings remain in both columns; editing one leaves the other unchanged.
admin.stats_help: Enable, order or add metrics. Counts respect visibility. Online means active members, respects privacy, and requires either online-count permission or FoF’s online-list permission. Guest sessions are not counted.
